sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): dancing forward light on his feet, the arms swinging, the feather cloak streaming low behind him as in image 1, the LEGS CHANGING OVER as written for each frame
sheets.weapons: HIS HANDS go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour); where the old frame shows a golden feather in his hand, draw it there. THE FEATHER CLOAK as big as in image 1 and shaped as the pale figure has it - wrapped round him, whirling round him in the spins, spread like wings in the throws, streaming behind him in the dashes - its red-and-gold shoulders, long gold-orange feathers and rainbow tips. Only him: no flying feathers, no sparkles, no trails.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) straight down under his hips, his grey-violet bird-claw foot flat on the ground line; the FAR leg (the darker one) bent and kicked back behind him, its foot off the ground. Frame 2: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the near leg still planted under his hips, bending; the far leg swinging down from behind, its foot low, just off the ground behind the planted one. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must show a different leg planted. Draw the legs AS WRITTEN for each frame, not the pale figure's (the old 1x legs are too small to read; runs drawn after them kept the same legs in all 8 frames: 「走路没有换腿」). The body, the head, the arms and the feather cloak follow the pale figure. The cloak trails low behind him but is NOT a leg: his two legs in the baggy green trousers carry him.

sheets.weapons: HIS HANDS go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour); where the old frame shows a golden feather in his hand, draw it there. THE FEATHER CLOAK as big as in image 1 and shaped as the pale figure has it - wrapped round him, whirling round him in the spins, spread like wings in the throws, streaming behind him in the dashes - its red-and-gold shoulders, long gold-orange feathers and rainbow tips. Only him: no flying feathers, no sparkles, no trails.
